facts.text: Verify trims each requested id, drops blanks and de-duplicates with StringComparer.Ordinal before it counts them.
Verify throws DossierRequestException with code invalid_request when no non-blank id is supplied.
at: verify requires at least one fact id

facts.text: Verify throws invalid_request when the de-duplicated id count exceeds MaxVerifyIds, and the message names the maximum and the count received.
at: verify accepts at most {MaxVerifyIds} fact ids, got {ids.Count}

facts.text: Verify reads Revision with HeadRevision inside the same deferred transaction that describes the facts.
Verify describes the ids in request order after trimming and de-duplicating them.
CurrencyReader caches each row, each fact inputs, each staleness verdict and each replacement for the lifetime of the reader.
CurrencyRefs limits currency queries to kind fact and the rels derived_from, refutes, contradicts and supersedes.
Involved returns ids that carry a currency ref or are its target, using one query that expands the id list with json_each.
at: AND r.fact_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($ids))

facts.text: NonLive walks facts whose status is neither superseded nor retracted and that carry or receive a currency ref, in rowid order.
at: WHERE f.status NOT IN ('superseded', 'retracted') AND f.id IN (

facts.text: NonLive keeps a candidate only when Describe reports stale or contested.
Describe sets Current true only on the live branch, so stale, contested, superseded, retracted and unknown results leave it false.
Successor takes the earliest-written candidate among the next fact with the same subject, kind and key and the facts carrying a supersedes ref.
at: WHERE $key IS NOT NULL AND f.subject_id = $subject AND f.kind = $kind AND f.key = $key AND f.rowid > $rowid

facts.text: Replacement caches its answer per input id, so many dependents sharing one input compute the chain walk once.
FindReplacement tracks visited ids in a seen set, so a successor loop in a hand-edited store ends with null instead of spinning.
Changed reports a retracted input with State retracted and no ReplacedBy.
Inputs reads derived_from refs of kind fact in seq order and drops a repeated target while keeping its first position.
at: rel = 'derived_from' AND kind = 'fact' ORDER BY seq

facts.text: IsStale stops its ancestry walk at a changed input because what that input derived from no longer matters to its dependents.
at: A changed input ends the walk

facts.text: IsStale settles the collected ancestry as a fixed point, so a derivation cycle terminates and every member gets the same verdict.
StaleReasons skips a derived_from input the store does not hold, treating it as unchecked rather than as evidence of change.
at: An input this store does not hold cannot be checked

facts.text: When an input is itself stale, StaleReasons records a derived_from reason with State set to StatusStale.
Stands counts a party only while its stored status is neither superseded nor retracted and it is not stale.
ContestedReasons orders inbound parties by created_at, then the fact rowid, then the ref seq.
ContestedReasons adds outbound parties only for a contradicts ref, never for an outbound refutes, and skips a fact ref to itself.
ContestedReasons adds a party once per rel and fact pair, so a repeated dispute yields one reason.
Successor finds the next fact by rowid rather than reading the slot table, which a correction or a retraction empties.
at: not from the slot table, which a correction or a retraction empties

facts.text: FindReplacement stops at the first successor whose status is neither superseded nor retracted and returns its id.
Changed reports a superseded input whose replacement has a different content hash with State superseded and the replacement id.
IsStale stores the verdict for every fact it walked, so a later question about a shared ancestor does not walk it again.
ChangeColumns returns only the first 160 characters of a fact text with substr.
ChangeColumns fills Actor from provenance actor only when the row is a facts insert and its provenance is valid JSON.
at: CASE WHEN c.tbl = 'facts' AND c.op = 'insert' AND json_valid(f.provenance) THEN json_extract(f.provenance, '$.actor') END

facts.text: ChangeFrom joins facts and subjects with LEFT JOIN, so a journal row survives a fact or subject it can no longer resolve.
at: FROM changes c LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.id = c.fact_id LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = c.subject_id

facts.text: Every nullable ChangeRow column is marked JsonIgnore Never, so it serializes as an explicit null instead of being omitted.
ReadChanges returns an empty page with Reset true when since is ahead of the head or below the oldest retained seq minus one.
Without a subject filter ReadChanges sets Next to the last returned seq, or the head when no row came back.
With a subject filter ReadChanges queries limit plus one row so the extra row can say whether more of the subject remains.
ReadChanges sets the cursor to the head for a subject page that is not truncated, so the cursor may skip other subjects rows.
ReadChanges clamps the requested limit into the range 1 to 500 before querying.
ReadChanges without a subject marks the page Truncated when the last returned seq is below the head.
ReadChangesLast reports Truncated when the oldest returned seq is greater than the oldest retained seq.
ReadChangesLast with a subject asks for limit plus one row and drops the oldest when an extra row came back.
ReadChangesLast clamps the requested limit into the range 1 to 500 before querying.
SubjectFilter throws DossierRequestException with code subject_not_found when the subject resolves to no subject id, so a typo cannot read as nothing changed.
ReadWindow reports the oldest seq as the head plus one when the changes table holds no row.
at: var oldest = command.ExecuteScalar() is long min ? min : head + 1;

facts.text: Show reads the fact, its refs and its attachments inside one ReadSnapshot before it derives status and searches inbound.
Show overwrites the stored status with the derived Status and copies ReplacedBy and Why from the same derivation.
Show builds Inbound by calling Search with RefTarget set to the id, Direction in and Limit MaxLimit.
at: var inbound = Search(new SearchRequest { RefTarget = id, Direction = "in", Limit = MaxLimit }).Hits;

facts.text: ReadRefs returns a fact refs ordered by seq.
at: FROM refs WHERE fact_id = $id ORDER BY seq

facts.text: ReadRefs maps a NULL valid column to null and otherwise to a bool that is false for zero.
ReadAttachments returns a fact attachments ordered by sha256.
at: FROM attachments WHERE fact_id = $id ORDER BY sha256

facts.text: ParseJson returns null for empty text and for JSON that fails to parse, rather than throwing.
Retract returns RetractResult with success false for an id the facts table does not hold, before any write.
Retract guards its UPDATE with status, text and data checks so a second retract of the same fact writes nothing and cannot bump the revision.
at: AND (status != 'retracted' OR text IS NOT NULL OR data IS NOT NULL)

facts.text: Retract deletes the facts_fts row by the rowid it looked up from facts before the tombstone update.
Retract deletes the fact slots row so the slot the fact occupied is cleared.
Retract collects the distinct sha256 values of the fact attachments before it decides which blobs to delete.
at: SELECT DISTINCT sha256 FROM attachments WHERE fact_id = $id

facts.text: Retract commits its transaction before it deletes any attachment blob, and skips a blob file that no longer exists.
Retract prunes the change journal inside its write transaction, before the commit.
Retract looks for the attachment blob at the path BlobRoot joined with the sha256 name.
Retract opens a plain write transaction rather than a deferred one.
CountLiveFactsForSha opens its own connection and counts attachments rows joined to facts whose status is live.
PruneChanges returns without deleting while the oldest seq is at least retention plus slack behind the head.
When it does run, PruneChanges deletes journal rows with seq at or below the head minus retention.
HeadRevision parses meta revision with NumberStyles.Integer and the invariant culture, and returns 0 when the text is not a number.
at: long.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var value)

facts.text: ReadRows reads a NULL column as null and converts every other value to a string with the invariant culture.
